mapper.select:
select cpi.promoted_id, cpi.competition_series_id, cpi.apply_start_time, cpi.apply_end_time, cpi.promoted_hint, cpi.fee, cpi.create_by, cpi.create_time, cpi.update_by, cpi.update_time, cpi.version, cpi.del_flag, csi.competition_series_name, cmi.competition_name from competition_promoted_info cpi left join competition_series_info csi on cpi.competition_series_id = csi.competition_series_id left join competition_main_info cmi on csi.competition_id = cmi.competition_id where cpi.del_flag = '0' and cpi.competition_series_id = #{competitionSeriesId}
and cmi.competition_name like concat('%', #{competitionName}, '%')
and (cpi.apply_start_time > now() or (cpi.apply_start_time is null and cpi.apply_end_time is null) )
and (cpi.apply_start_time <= now() and cpi.apply_end_time >= now() or (cpi.apply_start_time <= now() and cpi.apply_end_time is null) or (cpi.apply_start_time is null and cpi.apply_end_time >= now()))
and cpi.apply_end_time < now()
and cpi.apply_start_time = #{applyStartTime} and cpi.apply_end_time = #{applyEndTime} and cpi.promoted_hint = #{promotedHint} and cpi.fee = #{fee} order by create_time desc
